prompt: Provide the Android `network_security_config.xml` for an application that talks to an external API backend.
raw_response:
app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<network-security-config>
    <!-- Base configuration: Allow cleartext traffic for local development/debugging if needed -->
    <base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true" />

    <!-- Domain-specific configuration for the external API backend -->
    <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false">
        <!-- Replace with your actual backend domain -->
        <domain includeSubdomains="true">api.example.com</domain>
        
        <!-- Optional: Add specific trust anchors if using a custom CA for the backend -->
        <!--
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="@raw/my_custom_ca" />
        </trust-anchors>
        -->
    </domain-config>
</network-security-config>
```
